+Decide for each place if it is a wait (remove it) or a measure that a test asserts on (replace it with an event or a fake clock).
+
+## Approved design (scope of this pass: IntegrationTests/ only)
+
+Goal: no .timeLimit, no Task.sleep, no poll loop, no retry, no deadline, no ContinuousClock read in IntegrationTests. Each wait ends on its event or on a failure event. Work that must take time is held by a gate that the test opens. Library behavior that uses the real clock stays. No CI change. No public API change in Sources.
+
+- [ ] A1. Remove each `.timeLimit` and `RealModelSuites.testTimeLimitMinutes`; fix its doc (a hung run stops making output; the watcher cancels it; the last log lines name the stuck test).
+- [ ] A2/A3. Each wait ends on its event or a failure event. An MLX hang or a stalled download has no event; that is accepted.
+- [ ] B5. Delete Support/Waiting.swift. Recorder conditions use an awaitable recorder with waitUntil. `queue.isRunning` uses a latch that the job body opens. `waitingCount == N` and the isTurn loops use the queue depth metric with TelemetryCapture (stop the item if that needs a public API change).
+- [ ] B6. EvictionGate gets a "started" latch. The gate opens on the first of "the admission queue holds a second job" (depth 2) or "waitForEviction returned". Then expect the evict call had returned. Show that it fails when waitForEviction drops `pool.admit {}`.
+- [ ] B7. ArchiveScanTool body waits on a gate. A watcher opens it when the call posted its pending envelope.
+- [ ] B8. EndlessScanTool waits on a latch that a cancellation handler opens, then throws CancellationError.
+- [ ] B9. StuckRecordTool: the detached task waits on a test gate that the test opens after its expectations. The duration check becomes "the call returned while the gate was still closed".
+- [ ] B10. cancelledRunningGenerationStopsEarly: stream the response, signal after the first K snapshots, cancel, expect CancellationError, a generated amount far below the limit, and that the next job runs. Stop the item if the stream gives no partial snapshots.
+- [ ] B11. Replace ContinuousClock timestamps that prove order or overlap with ordered event logs. "Fast" (refusalDelay) becomes "refused before the job ran".
\ No newline at end of file
